header.superHtml:
Introducing SuperMouth's groundbreaking manual toothbrush, a true revolution in oral care since 1938. Born from cutting-edge technology, this toothbrush is meticulously crafted by scanning thousands of teeth, ensuring its bristles conform flawlessly to every contour of your teeth.

With over 10,000 ultra-soft, yet highly efficient bristles, it offers an unparalleled cleaning experience, far surpassing the average toothbrush's 2,500 bristles. Each stroke is gentle yet effective, providing a superior clean that you can both see and feel.

Available in multiple stunning colors and elegantly designed, this toothbrush isn't just a tool for oral hygiene; it's a statement of style and innovation in your daily routine. Experience the future of oral care with SuperMouth – where design meets functionality for a truly exceptional brushing experience.

  • First major bristle innovation since 1938.
  • Cleans up to 30 times better than a manual brush
  • Patent pending design with over 10,000 ultra-soft bristles.
  • Scanned teeth for perfect fit.
  • Gentle, efficient cleaning.
  • Multiple stylish color options.

left.title: Whole-Mouth Satisfaction Guaranteed
left.text: We are so confident you'll love our customized oral care solutions, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Experience the best in oral health—risk-free.

reviews.name: Lisa
reviews.title: Best toothbrush ever!
reviews.body: I love this toothbrush.  The bristles are soft and I feel it gets my teeth clean.  I just bought another.

reviews.name: Gail
reviews.body: The adaptation of this brush to the teeth and gum line is great.  It helps prevent more recession

reviews.name: Mary
reviews.title: Soft and polishing!
reviews.body: This tooth brush was a pleasant surprise. Love the soft bristles. It’s been great for my kids since they’re notorious for brushing too hard!

reviews.name: Laurie
reviews.title: so soft
reviews.body: One of the softest toothbrushes I've ever had! Great for my gums and teeth

reviews.name: Jason
reviews.title: Great toothbrush but not for me
reviews.body: I wanted to love this toothbrush, and honestly did. The bristles are the softest I've ever tried, almost hard to tell if you're even brushing.  Despite the smaller brush head, it seemed to get places a little easier than my prior brush.  That said, and I don't understand it, but my teeth sensitivity worsened using it.  And not just this one, but everything I try other than what I currently use.  Sucks because this brush really is as advertised.
